takes.line: d|toad|Round 3. Best 3 out of 3.
takes.label: new take
takes.script: [croaky, preening] Round 3. [cocky, insistent] Best 3 out of 3.

takes.line: d|toad|Round 2. Best 2 out of 2.
takes.label: new take
takes.script: [croaky, smug] Round 2. [cocky, insistent] Best 2 out of 2.

takes.line: d|toad|Round 5. Best 5 out of 5.
takes.label: new take
takes.script: [hoarse, giddy] Round 5. [cocky, straining] Best 5 out of 5.

takes.line: d|toad|Round 4. Best 4 out of 4.
takes.label: new take
takes.script: [croaky, winded] Round 4. [cocky, tired] Best 4 out of 4.

takes.line: d|toad|...rigged. The whole game is RIGGED.
takes.label: new take
takes.script: [low, sour] ...rigged. [loud, indignant] The whole game is RIGGED.

takes.line: d|toad|Best two out of three. Best three out of five.
takes.label: new take
takes.script: [wheedling, desperate] Best two out of three. [pleading, croaky] Best three out of five.

takes.line: d|mudling|Oh no. Round two.
takes.label: new take
takes.script: [dismayed, nervous] Oh no... Round two.

takes.line: d|mudling|Every dance, I stood right here. Every song. Nobody ever asked.
takes.label: new take
takes.script: [shy, aching] Every dance, I stood right here. Every song. [small, wounded] Nobody ever asked.
